title: 鵝掌藤葉片圖集（4×4 枝，RGBA，給中庭花台的葉片卡）
generator: CPU numpy 程式畫小葉輪廓／主脈／對折明暗／葉色／乾尖／灰塵（alpha 也是程式輪廓）＋本地 SDXL（RealVisXL V5.0 img2img＋union ControlNet tile，黑底合成圖當輸入）只取葉面內高頻
license: RealVisXL V5.0（CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M，可商用）、controlnet-union-sdxl-promax（Apache-2.0）；輸入只有程式底稿；可商用、可公開
photo_rule: 照片只用眼睛看（03_中庭與玻璃天幕 花台灌木）；沒有當貼圖、沒有 img2img／ControlNet 輸入
people_rule: 提示詞含 no people/no person/no figure/no face/no hands，負面詞含 people, human, figure, silhouette, face, hand, fingers；4 塊逐張看過
layout: 4×4 格，每格 512 px（2k）＝0.30 m；葉柄往格子中心外伸出（3D 的莖接在那裡）
alpha: A 通道＝葉面覆蓋（alphaTest 0.5）；RGB 往透明區外推
used_by: tools/sandbox/scenes/_tc-site.ts shrub()（中庭噴水池花台）；材質名 plant

sdxl.prompt: top-down studio photograph of a single sprig of schefflera arboricola dwarf umbrella tree leaves, palmate compound leaf, glossy dark green leaflets, some dusty and yellowing, a few dry brown tips, isolated on pure black background, sharp focus, photorealistic, 8k, no people, no person, no figure, no face, no hands
sdxl.neg: people, person, human, figure, silhouette, face, eyes, mouth, skull, hand, fingers, insect, animal, flower, text, letters, watermark, logo, pot, soil, table, room, background objects, perspective, cartoon, painting, illustration, 3d render, frame, border
